No proxy:
CmdExec / PowerShell step runs as the
SQL Server Agent SERVICE ACCOUNT.

- Often over-privileged on the box
- Same identity for every job
- sysadmin members are exempt
  (one reason shops mandate proxies)
caption: A robocopy step shouldn't inherit whatever privilege Agent's service account has.
The credential's name must match the Windows account for an Agent proxy.
